title: Cybersecurity Trends 2026: Navigating the New Threat Landscape
description: Join IEEE BUC for a virtual session on the changing cybersecurity landscape, featuring guest speakers from the University of Maryland Global Campus.
longDescription:
The IEEE Student Branch at Buraimi University College welcomes guest speakers from the University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC) for a webinar on cybersecurity trends in 2026.

Join Dr. Mayyada Al Hammoshi and Dr. Chad Whistle for “Navigating the New Threat Landscape.” The session will take place online via Google Meet, from 6:00 to 7:30 PM Oman time.

Admission is free. Visit the official IEEE vTools event page for registration and attendance information.

speakers.name: Dr. Mayyada Al Hammoshi
speakers.role: Collegiate Faculty for Assessment and Evaluation in Cyber Technology

speakers.name: Dr. Chad Whistle
speakers.role: Assistant Dean for Portfolio Lifecycle & Student Success

title: IEEE Student Branch Launch Ceremony
description: The IT Department at Al Buraimi University College organized the inauguration of the IEEE BUC Student Branch, showcasing the college's dedication to technical innovation and enhancing the student research environment. The event was honored by the presence of Dr. Yahya Al Balushi, Vice Chair of the IEEE Oman Section, who delivered an insightful lecture on the role of IEEE in empowering students professionally and academically.
longDescription:

title: IEEE Xtreme Programming Competition (IEEEXtreme 19.0)
description: Participated in the global IEEEXtreme 19.0 programming competition, a 24-hour challenge where IEEE student members compete to solve algorithmic and programming problems under time pressure.
longDescription: Participated in the global IEEEXtreme 19.0 programming competition, a 24-hour challenge where IEEE student members compete to solve algorithmic and programming problems under time pressure. The competition focused on problem-solving, teamwork, and coding skills.

title: Online Workshop for IEEE Student Branch Counselors and Chapter Advisors
description: Participated in an online workshop organized by the IEEE Region 8 Student Activities Committee aimed at sharing best practices for Student Branch Counselors and Chapter Advisors.
longDescription: Participated in an online workshop organized by the IEEE Region 8 Student Activities Committee, aimed at sharing best practices, exchanging experiences, and discussing challenges faced by Student Branch Counselors and Chapter Advisors. The session focused on strengthening collaboration and enhancing support for IEEE student communities across Region 8.

title: IEEE Authorship and Open Access Symposium
description: IEEE tips and best practices workshop for getting published, featuring advice from IEEE editors on paper structure and open access.
longDescription: Participated in an online IEEE symposium focused on authorship and open access publishing. The workshop provided practical guidance from IEEE editors on paper structure, keyword selection, manuscript preparation, and best practices to increase the chances of publication in IEEE journals.

title: Ice-breaking event
description: An afternoon of interactive games, peer learning and connections at BUC.
longDescription:
The IEEE BUC Student Branch announced an ice-breaking event for students to connect through interactive games, get to know each other and learn from their peers.

The published programme scheduled the event for Tuesday, 21 April 2026, from 11 AM to 3 PM in Building A, Room 407.
location: Building A, Room 407, Buraimi University College

title: Hands-on C++ problem-solving workshop
description: A beginner workshop series developing programming skills through practical challenges, discussion and collaborative problem solving.
longDescription:
The beginner series was advertised to start on 24 February 2026, with sessions on Tuesdays from 9 to 10 AM in Building A, Auditorium 2.

A first-day recap published on 3 March featured a session presented by Prof. Yasser Wazery. The 11 March post covered the third training day with Dr. Abeer Al-Sudairi, moving from basic concepts to intensive problem solving.

The 15 April recap highlighted challenging tasks, different solution approaches and discussion among participants. These are the publication dates of the recaps, not additional confirmed event dates.
location: Building A, Auditorium 2, Buraimi University College
